title: Bill Priestley studying at Columbia while playing in New York
summary: Ashcraft tells how Priestley played with Waring five shows a day at the Roxy while studying architecture.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Didn't, uh, Bill, uh, Priestley get into something of that sort, too?
Well, when Bill Priestley left Princeton, he had one year of architecture to do at Columbia. And so he played with Warrings.
While, uh, while he was going to Columbia. Oh, is that so? It was simultaneous?
Yeah, which is quite a feat, I might add. Five shows a day at the Roxy's.

Uh, he traveled one whole summer with them. Oh, yes. But then, uh, then he went to, to, um, uh, Germany to study architecture.
